* fix: support named imports of envinfo from ESM

The commonjs2 bundle assigns module.exports at runtime, so Node's
cjs-module-lexer finds no named exports and `import { run } from 'envinfo'`
throws in ESM. Append the no-op `0 && (module.exports = { ... })` hint
after minification so Node can detect cli, helpers, main and run.

* feat: ship TypeScript type definitions

Add index.d.ts with category items, presets, options and helpers typed
by name, and test it with TypeScript 6 and 7:

- test-d/contract.test-d.ts checks the types against src/ (allowJs), so
  a helper, category item or preset added without types fails to build
- test-d/index.test-d.ts covers valid and invalid usage
- check:package runs attw on the packed tarball

These replace @types/envinfo, which is missing 23 helpers and types
helper results as strings.

* ci: test on Node.js 24 and 26

feat: ship TypeScript type definitions (#307)

* fix: detect Neovim in the IDEs category

presets.defaults listed 'NVim', but the helper is getNvimInfo and reports
'Nvim', so Neovim was never looked up. Also report 'Nvim' (not 'Vim') on
unsupported platforms so it cannot overwrite the Vim entry.

* fix: support named imports of envinfo from ESM

The commonjs2 bundle assigns module.exports at runtime, so Node's
cjs-module-lexer finds no named exports and `import { run } from 'envinfo'`
throws in ESM. Append the no-op `0 && (module.exports = { ... })` hint
after minification so Node can detect cli, helpers, main and run.

* feat: ship TypeScript type definitions

Add index.d.ts with category items, presets, options and helpers typed
by name, and test it with TypeScript 6 and 7:

- test-d/contract.test-d.ts checks the types against src/ (allowJs), so
  a helper, category item or preset added without types fails to build
- test-d/index.test-d.ts covers valid and invalid usage
- check:package runs attw on the packed tarball

These replace @types/envinfo, which is missing 23 helpers and types
helper results as strings.

* ci: test on Node.js 24 and 26
